args.reason: The --dry-run item serves the inspection goal, but two DoD items build capability the PRD explicitly excludes: a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, and an --explain timeline with --since and --format filters. The first PRD goal says historical storage and query features are outside this PRD. This is gold-plating beyond the declared goals, not under-citation. The Phase-1 view that the history log is a natural extension of inspection contradicts the PRD wording.
